governance.purpose: Provide explicit item schemas and collection-level validation rules for all 53 generic array fields.
governance.normative_boundary: This document is a proposed amendment. It does not alter the Owner-approved gene IO baseline, the 72 schema files, Genome, runtime behavior, main, or production authority.
source_limits: Genome gene records currently declare permitted_effects=[none], dependencies=[], failure_semantics=fail-closed.
No capability grant, authorization, execution, external write, model mutation or promotion may be inferred from collection contents.
Where the authoritative source does not define a scale or controlled vocabulary, this proposal marks the choice as a proposed convention requiring Owner ratification.
governance.approval_required_before: Applying these item definitions to the normative contract and 72 JSON Schemas.

validation_conventions.objects: All item objects use additionalProperties=false and explicit required members.
validation_conventions.identifiers: Non-empty strings; canonical syntax remains governed by the referenced gene's identifier registry.
validation_conventions.timestamps: RFC 3339 date-time where a timestamp is required.
validation_conventions.digests: Non-empty strings until an authoritative digest algorithm/encoding is bound; consumers must compare exact algorithm-bound digests.
validation_conventions.empty_collections: Allowed unless minItems is explicitly specified.
validation_conventions.fail_closed: Malformed items, unresolved references, duplicate identity keys, cycles, invalid authority, or inconsistent evidence reject the containing contract.
proposed_conventions_requiring_ratificat: The listed relation, polarity and evaluation-status vocabularies.

An execution request or execution context must never implicitly create or increase authorization.
External input is untrusted by default until an explicit trust determination establishes otherwise.
Failure to establish a required security condition must not result in authorization or execution.

cross_collection_invariants: All object members are closed; unknown item properties are rejected.
All identifiers and references are version-bound; unresolved references fail closed.
A collection item never grants authority; authority and authorization must be validated by their designated genes.
Outputs must preserve evidence and distinguish absent, invalid, rejected, excluded, unresolved and inconclusive states.
Ordering is preserved or deterministic only where specified; no consumer may assume arbitrary array order is semantically meaningful.
Where two output collections partition an input set, their identifiers must be disjoint and complete.

acceptance_tests.positive_cases: At least one valid item per item schema, plus valid empty arrays where allowed.
acceptance_tests.cross_reference: Validate every gene_id/side/field against the approved amendment's 53 generic-array declarations; no extra or missing collection is accepted.
